tasks.title: Contribute by tencent: prepared statement can't execute match+rollup twice.

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: 完整MATCH+ROLLUP预处理执行两次用例，仅debug可启用hypergraph，材料齐备。

test_spec.setup: 支持hypergraph的目标debug构建；t(x varchar100,FULLTEXT(x))插入abc/xyz/NULL/abc abc/abc xyz。
test_spec.steps: 开启hypergraph；ANALYZE；PREPARE正文MATCH AGAINST并GROUP BY score WITH ROLLUP HAVING score>0；EXECUTE两次。
test_spec.oracle: 第二次执行不应崩溃，结果与首次保持同义；不能把普通GA拒绝hypergraph当缺陷。
test_spec.target_applicability: 仅目标debug实验优化器适用，单独标记构建范围。

comments.author: tianfeng li
MySQL Verification Team
comments.text:
Hello tianfeng li,

Thank you for the report and test case.
Observed that 8.0.33 debug build is affected(hypergraph optimizer does not yet support 'use in non-debug builds').

regards,
Umesh
